summary: End-to-end verification of the migrated in-workspace NekSathi backend (FastAPI + MongoDB in /app/backend/server.py) and the Expo web frontend. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL, covering auth (login/register/OTP/me), personal safety (SOS, contacts, safe-zones, live-share, location), family (create/join with invite code, 404 for bad code), Smart QR (vehicles/tags/cards CRUD + update + lost_mode + public scan resolvers + public incident/alert/card-message), alerts + incidents reflecting the public reports, and devices (register + lock/siren state + intruder + sim-swap + 404 for bogus id). Frontend: demo-login lands on Home with all testIDs (sos-button, home-alerts-button with red dot, stat cards, live share); tab navigation to Family (invite chip + member list), Safety (contacts/safe-zones/history/scan/receipts sub-cards), Security (Anti-theft segment lists real devices with Report intruder + SIM swap actions, Smart QR segment toggles), and Profile (edit profile, 5 preference toggles, logout) all render without red screen / page errors. Home->Alerts screen shows every alert generated by the public-scan tests (sim_swap, intruder, card_message, found). Register-device modal opens with device-name-input + overlay-submit-button. Home scan button opens the scan-report page with the expected 'Camera access needed' web gate. Push preference toggle succeeds. Logout returns to /login. Deprecated packages detected: none. Only cosmetic RN-Web warnings remain (shadow*, pointerEvents, React 19 ref) — same as iteration_1 and coming from third-party libs.

issues: 'Welcome back!' toast still overlaps the 'Hi, Demo' header on 390px width (carried over from iteration_1). Offset toast below the header or shorten the greeting.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated - use 'boxShadow' (repeated on app load, likely from GlassCard / NeonButton / SOSButton).
React-Native-Web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated - use style.pointerEvents (fires after login).

action_items: (Cosmetic) Replace 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' in GlassCard/NeonButton/SOSButton to silence RN-Web warnings.
(Cosmetic) Audit callers using the legacy pointerEvents prop and move to style.pointerEvents.
(Cosmetic) Reposition the 'Welcome back!' toast so it doesn't overlap the greeting on narrow widths.
No functional fixes required - migrated backend and all critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via clean() helper; uses uuid string ids as required.
JWT_SECRET is read from backend/.env with a dev fallback - good; TOKEN_DAYS=30, HS256.
bcrypt.hashpw + checkpw wrapped with a safe verify_pw that swallows ValueError/TypeError (no plaintext leak on legacy rows).
OTP dev_code is only returned because the WhatsApp provider is stubbed; document that this must be removed before production.
All /api routes are prefixed via APIRouter(prefix='/api') and demo user is idempotently seeded on startup - safe to restart.
current_user() correctly handles missing/expired/invalid JWT with 401.
Family creator is auto-set to owner; join enforces the 5-member cap and 404 on bad invite code.
seed_data_creation: Backend now persists to LOCAL MongoDB (test_database). Demo user is auto-seeded on startup. Tests create TEST_-prefixed users (register + otp verify + family owner + joiner), vehicles/tags/cards on the demo user, one TEST_Device, and several public alerts/incidents. Emergency contacts and safe-zones are cleaned up in the test; other test data intentionally remains for the UI to display.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is now IN-WORKSPACE at /app/backend/server.py (FastAPI + Motor + local Mongo). Frontend + backend both live behind EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL / EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL = https://mobile-safety-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo account demo@neksathi.app / demo1234 (login testID=fill-demo-button + login-submit-button). Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_neksathi_api.py (21 tests, all pass). OTP tests must NOT use `.local` TLD (pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs) - use `.test.example.com`. Camera scanner and react-native-maps are native-only (web shows a permission gate / static fallback image) - expected.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bugs to root cause. The migrated backend behaves identically to the previous external one for every route exercised by the app.
